name: azure-personal
description: Azure Personal Minecraft launcher for Windows

scripts.build:client-mod: client-mod\gradlew.bat -p client-mod build && client-mod\gradlew.bat -p client-mod -Pminecraft_version=1.20.2 -Pyarn_mappings=1.20.2+build.4 -Pfabric_version=0.91.6+1.20.2 build && client-mod\gradlew.bat -p client-mod -Pminecraft_version=1.20.3 -Pyarn_mappings=1.20.3+build.1 -Pfabric_version=0.91.1+1.20.3 build && client-mod\gradlew.bat -p client-mod -Pminecraft_version=1.20.4 -Pyarn_mappings=1.20.4+build.3 -Pfabric_version=0.97.2+1.20.4 build
scripts.build:setup: npm run build:client-mod && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win nsis --x64
scripts.release:windows: npm run build:client-mod && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win nsis --x64 --publish always
